# Original signature functions
```{r}
### MAMS
MAMS_6_mean <- function(counts) {
        genes = c("AIM2", "FCGR1BP", "CD274", "GBP1", "SMARCD3", "FLVCR2")
    return(colMeans(counts[genes, ]))
}

## geometric mean
gm_mean = function(x, na.rm=TRUE){
  exp(sum(log(x[x > 0]), na.rm=na.rm) / length(x))
}

## RISK6
calc_RiskGeo_6<-function(counts){
        gene_set1=c('GBP2','FCGR1BP','SERPING1')
        gene_set2=c('TUBGCP6','TRMT2A','SDR39U1')
      return(gm_mean(counts[gene_set1],TRUE) - 
               gm_mean(counts[gene_set2],TRUE))
}

### Sweeney-3
sweeney3 = function(counts){
   c((log2(counts['GBP5',]) + log2(counts['DUSP3',])) / 2 ) - log2(counts['KLF2',])
}
```

# Read in data
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
## get counts
count_dir <- ".../data"
count_files <- list.files(count_dir, pattern = "_counts.csv",full.names = TRUE)
count_files
count_list <- lapply(count_files, read_csv)
count_list[[1]]<-count_list[[1]]%>%
  select(-index)

counts_filtered<-lapply(count_list, function(counts){
  keep <- rowSums(counts >= 10) >= 4
  counts[keep,]
})
```

### Count mtx formatting
#### Week 0
```{r}
## Format individual count files; put back into list
df<-counts_filtered[[1]]

## Correct gene names
df<-df %>%
  mutate(symbol = case_when(
    gene_id == "ENSG00000228696.12" ~ "ARL17B",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000169627.9" ~ "BOLA2B",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000283378.1" ~ "CNTNAP3C",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000237541.4" ~ "HLA-DQA2",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000260075.1" ~ "NSFP1",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000183889.13" ~ "NPIPA6",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000170667.16" ~ "RASA4B",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000205572.11" ~ "SERF1B",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000205571.15" ~ "SMN2",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000274512.6" ~ "TBC1D3L",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000269226.8" ~ "TMSB15C",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000278970.5" ~ "HEIH",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000278662.6" ~ "GOLGA6L10",
    .default = symbol
  ))

# Novel transcripts - drop because probably not included in published signatures?
novel_transcripts<-c('ENSG00000226266.9','ENSG00000289720.1','ENSG00000285508.2',
                    'ENSG00000258790.1','ENSG00000289750.1','ENSG00000289755.2',
                    'ENSG00000285723.2')
df<- df[!(df$gene_id %in% novel_transcripts),]


# Same gene, different transcript name? Drop lowest expression?
duplicate_transcripts<-c('ENSG00000080947.16','ENSG00000287542.1','ENSG00000286112.1',
                    'ENSG00000280987.4','ENSG00000223705.12', 'ENSG00000285253.1',
                    'ENSG00000274615.1')
df <- df[!(df$gene_id %in% duplicate_transcripts),]


# drop rows with duplicate gex values + gene names (have different transcript)
counts_r <- unique( df[ , 2:17 ] )

# set rownames as symbol and drop gene_ids/old symbol
df_temp<-tibble::column_to_rownames(counts_r,var='symbol')
colnames(df_temp)

### Reassign
counts_filtered[[1]]<-df_temp
```

## Metadata
```{r}
metadata<- read_csv('.../metadata.csv')
dat<-tibble::column_to_rownames(metadata,var='scrno')
dat$`...1`<-NULL
dat$visit<-NULL

### for all dfs in counts_filtered
ignore_cols<-c("gene_id", "symbol")

metadata_list <- lapply(counts_filtered, function(df) {
  cols_to_keep <- setdiff(colnames(df), ignore_cols)
  matched_rows <- dat[match(cols_to_keep, rownames(dat)), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(matched_rows) <- cols_to_keep
  matched_rows
})
```

# Set up SummarizedExperiment objects
## Week 0
```{r}
## set objects
se_0<-SummarizedExperiment(list(counts = as.matrix(counts_filtered[[1]])),
                         colData=DataFrame(metadata_list[[1]]))
se_0<- mkAssay(se_0, log = TRUE, counts_to_CPM = TRUE)

# Get DESeq norm. ### will this be a problem if I've subset by the genes already? Recover how this is normalized
data_in<-SummarizedExperiment::assay(se_0,'counts')
res<-deseq2_norm_rle(data_in)

## make a new object
w0_norm<-SummarizedExperiment(list(counts=res),
                         colData=DataFrame(metadata_list[[1]]))

# Get VST trans
## DESeq with normalized counts
dds_0<- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=round(res),
                               colData=DataFrame(metadata_list[[1]]),
                               design = ~1)

## Now transform with rlog/VST and save count mtx
vsd<-vst(dds_0, blind=TRUE)
check<-vsd@assays@data@listData[[1]]
## add transformed mtx to SE object
w0_norm@assays@data@listData[["vst_counts"]]<-check

### Add log counts to w0_norm
w0_norm@assays@data@listData[["log_counts"]]<-se_0@assays@data$log_counts
```

# Gene enrichment scores
## W0
```{r}
## Run the TBSignatureProfiler to score the signatures in the data
gsea_sigs<-TBsignatures[c("Heycken_FAIL_22", "Long_RES_10","Thompson_RES_5",
                "Darboe_RISK_11", "Thompson_FAIL_13", "Tabone_RES_25", 
                 "Manneh_RES_7")]
sigs<-c("Heycken_FAIL_22", "Long_RES_10","Thompson_RES_5",
                "Darboe_RISK_11", "Thompson_FAIL_13", "Tabone_RES_25", 
                 "Manneh_RES_7")
```

```{r}
gsea_logCPM_0 <- runTBsigProfiler(input = se_0,
                                  useAssay = "log_counts_cpm",
                                  signatures = gsea_sigs,
                                  algorithm = "ssGSEA",
                                  combineSigAndAlgorithm = TRUE,
                                  parallel.sz = 1,
                                  update_genes=FALSE)
```

### Heatmaps
```{r}
gsea_res <- as.data.frame(colData(gsea_logCPM_0))[, c("label", sigs)]
DT::datatable(gsea_res) ## gives actual enrichment scores
```

```{r}
colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(6, "Spectral")
col.me <- circlize::colorRamp2(seq(from = -2, to = 2,
                                   length.out = 6), colors)

                 signatureColNames = names(gsea_sigs),
```

```{r}
melted_data <- reshape2::melt(gsea_auc_all,

# Color by timepoint

    melted_data$tp,
    new.order = c('0','1','2','9','14', '26'))
col_palette = c(brewer.pal(9,"Greens")[4:9])

# Color by Signature
melted_data$Signatures<-fct_reorder(melted_data$Signature, melted_data$value, 
                                    .fun=mean, .desc = TRUE)
col_palette = c(brewer.pal(8,"Dark2")[1:9])


### Change colors 
p<-ggplot(melted_data, aes(x=tp, y=value,color=Signatures)) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=LowerAUC, ymax=UpperAUC),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5) )+
  labs(title = "ssGSEA AUROC for recurrence prediction")+
  scale_y_continuous(name="AUC")+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = col_palette,
    labels=c('Manneh-7','Long-11','Darboe-11 [RISK11]',
                               'Tabone-25','TB22','Thompson-5 [RESPONSE5]',
                               'Thompson-13 [FAILURE]')
  ) + 
  labs(color = "Signatures", x="Weeks on treatment") +
  theme_minimal()

p

ggsave("AUROCs_GSEA_signatures.png", p, width = 9, height = 4,
       dpi=100)
```

```{r}
names(risk6_geo_scores)<-NULL

## Sweeney - do on normalized counts? - 
## OG paper: "microarray data: background corrected using normal-exponential method, 
##            then quantile-normalized", then log transformed
## Warinske validation paper: normalized the data then calculated log in formula

w0_ogmodels@colData@rownames == colnames(w0_mtx)

w0_ogmodels@colData@listData[["MAMS_6_mean_OriginalModel"]]<-MAMS_means
w0_ogmodels@colData@listData[["RISKgeo_6_OriginalModel"]]<-risk6_geo_scores
w0_ogmodels@colData@listData[["Sweeney_Add_OriginalModel"]]<-Sweeney_sc
```

### Tabone signature
```{r}
# by timepoint
tb25<-TBsignatures$Tabone_RES_25
tb27<-TBsignatures$Tabone_RES_27
tb27

## change names of genes to correspond with our mapping
tb27[5]<- 'SEPTIN4'
tb27[24]<- 'FCGR1BP'
```

#### WK26
```{r}
##### log2 FC on VST normalized counts
## get W0 in df form
w0_df<-as.data.frame(w0_mtx)
### subset by signatures
df<- w0_df[rownames(w0_df) %in% tb27,]

df<-t(df)
w0_tb27<-as.data.frame(df)
### Add time label to column end
colnames(w0_tb27) <-paste0(colnames(w0_tb27), "_0")

## WK26
## get W26 in df form
### 10.12.25: Use the normalised counts and then calculate the log2FC; not the
### VST_Transformed counts - this would complicate the FC calculation
w26_df<-as.data.frame(w26_mtx)
### subset by signatures
df<- w26_df[rownames(w26_df) %in% tb27,]
df<-t(df) 
w26_tb27<-as.data.frame(df)
### Add time label to column end
colnames(w26_tb27) <-paste0(colnames(w26_tb27), "_26")

# NOTE:# BA170X doesn't have both w0 and w26 timepoint - can't get FC
setdiff(rownames(w0_tb27), rownames(w26_tb27)) 

### Merge 
merged_df<-merge(w0_tb27, w26_tb27,by="row.names")

## Get FC by timepoint
fc_df<-data.frame(row.names=merged_df$Row.names)
test<-data.frame(row.names=merged_df$Row.names)

for (gene in tb27){
  col_t1<-paste0(gene, "_0")
  col_t2<-paste0(gene, "_26")
  if (col_t1 %in% colnames(merged_df)&& col_t2 %in% colnames(merged_df)){
    t1<-merged_df[[col_t1]]
    t2<-merged_df[[col_t2]]
    fc_df[[gene]]<-abs(log2((t2+1) / (t1 + 1))) ## changed 10.12.25
  }
}
```

#### WK1
```{r}
## get W1 in df form
w1_df<-as.data.frame(w1_mtx)
### subset by signatures
df<- w1_df[rownames(w1_df) %in% tb27,]
df<-t(df) 
w1_tb27<-as.data.frame(df)
### Add time label to column end
colnames(w1_tb27) <-paste0(colnames(w1_tb27), "_1")

# NOTE:# BA170X doesn't have both w0 and w26 timepoint - can't get FC
setdiff(rownames(w0_tb27), rownames(w1_tb27)) 

### Merge 
merged_df<-merge(w0_tb27, w1_tb27,by="row.names")

## Get FC by timepoint
fc_df<-data.frame(row.names=merged_df$Row.names)
test<-data.frame(row.names=merged_df$Row.names)

for (gene in tb27){
  col_t1<-paste0(gene, "_0")
  col_t2<-paste0(gene, "_1")
  if (col_t1 %in% colnames(merged_df)&& col_t2 %in% colnames(merged_df)){
    t1<-merged_df[[col_t1]]
    t2<-merged_df[[col_t2]]
    fc_df[[gene]]<-abs(log2((t2+1) / (t1 + 1)))
  }
}

fc_df$tb27_score<- rowMeans(fc_df) ## Mean molecular distance from T0 in 27 study genes
```

### ROC
```{r}
roc.list <- list(roc1 <- roc(y_true, sweeneymodel),
                roc6 <- roc(y_true, Tabone27),
                roc3 <- roc(y_true, MAMSmodel),
                roc5 <- roc(y_true, Vargas),
                roc2 <- roc(y_true, risk16model),
                roc4 <- roc(y_true, RISK6))

p <- ggroc(roc.list, aes=c("color"),legacy.axes = TRUE) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha=0.7, color = "grey") + 
  coord_equal()+
  labs(color='Gene Signature',x = "1-Specificity (FPR)", y = "Sensitivity (TPR)",
                title = 'AUC for recurrence prediction at Week 26 treatment')+
  scale_color_discrete(labels=c(paste0("Sweeney-3 (AUC =",
                                       sprintf("%.3f", roc.list[[1]]$auc), ")"),
                                paste0("RISK-16 (AUC =",
                                       sprintf("%.3f", roc.list[[2]]$auc), ")"),
                                paste0("MAMS-6 (AUC =",
                                       sprintf("%.3f", roc.list[[3]]$auc), ")"),
                                paste0("RISK-6 (AUC =",
                                       sprintf("%.3f", roc.list[[4]]$auc), ")"),
                                paste0("Vargas-18 (AUC =",
                                       sprintf("%.3f", roc.list[[5]]$auc), ")"),
                                paste0("Tabone-27 (AUC =",
                                       sprintf("%.3f", roc.list[[6]]$auc), ")")
                                )) 
p

ggsave('WK26_AUC_combined.png',p, dpi=600,bg='white',
       width = 6, height = 4)

```

#### Get Delong value for each AUC
```{r}
# Here results from roc == results from ROCit::rocit - match in TBSigProfiler
## W0
roc.list_0 <- list(
  Sweeney_3 = roc(roc_0$label_binary, roc_0$Sweeney_Add_OriginalModel),
  Risk_16 = roc(roc_0$label_binary, roc_0$Zak_RISK_16_OriginalModel),
  MAMS_6 = roc(roc_0$label_binary, roc_0$MAMS_6_mean_OriginalModel),
  RISK6 = roc(roc_0$label_binary, roc_0$RISKgeo_6_OriginalModel),
  Vargas = roc(roc_0$label_binary, roc_0$Vargas_OriginalModel)
)

# Get AUC + DeLong CI for each 
auc_df_0 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(roc.list_0), function(name) {
  roc_obj <- roc.list_0[[name]]
  ci_auc <- ci.auc(roc_obj, method = "delong")
  data.frame(
    Model = name,
    auc = as.numeric(roc_obj$auc),
    ci_lower = ci_auc[1],
    ci_upper = ci_auc[3]
  )
}))
```

#### Pairwise comparisons
##### Wk0
```{r}
model_names<-names(roc.list_0)
pairs<-combn(model_names, 2, simplify = F)

pairwise_0<-do.call(rbind, lapply(pairs, function(pair){
  roc1<-roc.list_0[[pair[1]]]
  roc2<-roc.list_0[[pair[2]]]
  
  res<-roc.test(roc1,roc2,method="delong",paired=T)
  
  data.frame(
    Model_1 = pair[1],
    Model_2 = pair[2],
    AUC_1 = as.numeric(roc1$auc),
    AUC_2 = as.numeric(roc2$auc),
    AUC_diff = as.numeric(roc1$auc)-as.numeric(roc2$auc),
    pval = res$p.value
  )
}))

```

```{r, fig.height=30, fig.width=30}
#### with Youden's index and WHO TTP
par(mfrow = c(3,2), pty="s", cex.lab=4, cex.axis=4,cex.main=4)

for (sig in names(roc.list_0)){
  plot(roc.list_0[[sig]], 
       print.thres="best",
       print.thres.best.method="youden",
       print.thres.cex=3,
       print.thres.pattern=ifelse(roc.list_0[[sig]]$percent, 
                                  "%.1f (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)", "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)"),
       main=sig,
       xlab="",
       ylab="")
  
  mtext("Specificity", side = 1, line = 4, cex = 3)
  mtext("Sensitivity", side = 2, line = 5, cex = 3)
  points(0.70, 0.90, pch=19, col="cornflowerblue", cex=3)  # 90% sens, 70% spec
  text(0.70, 0.90, "WHO TPP [90%,70%]",pos=3, cex=3,col="cornflowerblue")
}
#dev.off()
```

```{r}
### Change colors
```

# Misclassifications 
## Get sens/spec over time
```{r}
models <- list(
  Sweeney3_Add = "Sweeney_Add_OriginalModel",
  MAMS6_mean  = "MAMS_6_mean_OriginalModel",
  RISK6       = "RISKgeo_6_OriginalModel",
  Zak16       = "Zak_RISK_16_OriginalModel",
  Tabone      = "Tabone27_OriginalModel",
  Vargas      = "Vargas_OriginalModel"
)

make_df <- function(obj, timepoint, models) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(models), function(sig) {
    r <- rocit(score = obj[[models[[sig]]]], class = obj$label_binary)
    idx <- which.max(r$TPR - r$FPR)
    data.frame(
      signature = sig,
      timepoint = timepoint,
      TPR = r$TPR[idx],
      FPR = r$FPR[idx]
    )
  }))
}

all_dfs <- rbind(
  make_df(roc_1, 1, models),
  make_df(roc_2, 2, models),
  make_df(roc_9, 9, models),
  make_df(roc_14, 14, models),
  make_df(roc_26, 26, models)
)
### add timepoint 0
models <- list(
  Sweeney3_Add = "Sweeney_Add_OriginalModel",
  MAMS6_mean  = "MAMS_6_mean_OriginalModel",
  RISK6       = "RISKgeo_6_OriginalModel",
  Zak16       = "Zak_RISK_16_OriginalModel",
  Vargas      = "Vargas_OriginalModel"
)
temp0<-make_df(roc_0, 0, models)
all_dfs<-rbind(all_dfs,temp0)

all_dfs
```

```{r}
check<-dplyr::select(roc_26,contains(c("label","misclass")))
```

### WK26
#### Get calcs
##### Sweeney (from publication)
```{r}
test <- rocit(roc_26$Sweeney_Add_OriginalModel,roc_26$label_binary)
threshold<-test$Cutoff[[which.max(test$TPR - test$FPR)]]
### Add predicted labels
roc_26<-roc_26%>%
  mutate(Sweeney_add_prediction = if_else(Sweeney_Add_OriginalModel<threshold, 0,1))

### Get misclassification label
roc_26<-roc_26%>%
  mutate(Sweeney_add_misclass = if_else(label_binary == Sweeney_add_prediction, "FALSE","TRUE"))

### Get confusion matrix + metrics
#### For Sweeney - if a value is predicted ABOVE the negative threshold 
#### (i.e. less negative), then the class == 1
xtab<-table(roc_26$Sweeney_add_prediction, roc_26$label_binary)
acc<-confusionMatrix(xtab)$overall
metrics<-confusionMatrix(xtab)$byClass
```

## Metrics plots
```{r}
### Merge and format
metrics_tot<-rbind(metrics0,metrics1,metrics2,metrics9,metrics14,metrics26)
plt_df<-as.data.frame(t(reshape(metrics_tot, idvar="name", timevar="tp", 
                                direction="wide")))
colnames(plt_df)<- plt_df[1,]
plt_df<-plt_df[-1,]
plt_df$Week <-rep(c(0,1,2,9,14,26),each=6)
plt_df<-plt_df%>%
  mutate_if(is.character,as.numeric)
plt_df$sigs<-rep(c("Sweeney-3 [Add]","MAMS6 mean", 
                   "RISK6","Vargas","RISK16","Tabone-27"), times=6)


plt<-ggplot(plt_df, aes(x=Week, group=sigs, colour = sigs)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y=Accuracy),size = 0.5) +
#  ylim()+
  labs(title = "Accuracy",
       color = "Metric",
       y="Value",
       x="Weeks on treatment",
       ) +
  theme_minimal()
plt
```
#### Get table
```{r}
tbl_df<-plt_df[c("Accuracy","Pos Pred Value","Neg Pred Value","Precision",
                 "Recall","F1","Week", "sigs")]
tbl_df<-tbl_df%>%
  group_by(sigs)

metrics_tab<-gt(tbl_df)%>%
  fmt_number(columns=c("Accuracy","Pos Pred Value","Neg Pred Value","Precision",
                 "Recall","F1"),decimals = 2)%>%
  gtsave(filename='251210mm_Classification_metrics.docx') ## or .html/.png
```
